about: AG-1's shape check (U240): what a 0.8.5 (schema v3) reader needs of a graph node file and of each comment copy in it. Derived once from f3c4a7f: lib/server/graph.js isGraphNode (:46-48, the load's validate), graph.load's seq scan (:412, c.seq), clonePin (:54-59: replies an array of objects, anchor an object), restoreLiveToNode (:499, Array.isArray(node.comments)); lib/server/routes/comments.js's pin literal (:88-95) and reply literal (:152); public/app/comments.js captureAnchor (the four anchor fields the 0.8.5 chrome writes). A field marked required must be present; a present field must have its type. Extra fields (v, writer, provenance, edited) are allowed: the 0.8.5 reader ignores them.
